objective: Proof with exact finite computation. For each of the eight decorations (up to relabelling) left open by ROUND-PRICE-20261108-001B, a labelled parent collar survives the joint test when its neighbours can all be given surviving labelled collars that agree with it and with each other (unlabelled compatibility and equal labels on shared tiles), iterated with arc consistency to a fixed point. By ROUND-PRICE-20261108-001B's Theorem 1, a decoration whose off-law parent collars all die forces composition at every level, hence the pinwheel. Report, per decoration, the survivors in, and outside, its law.
status: Proved 2026-11-08 (ONE-BIT-20261108-001A-P001): the joint (radius-2) consistency test is sound for forcing, and on the eight open one-bit decorations it leaves off-law parent collars for each (35 to 110 labelled pinwheel keys outside the law, 13 to 191 non-keys), so none is settled by this route.
title: Joint consistency on the sixteen candidates' parent collars
